title: Groove: slightly off-grid, organic flow
doc: One method, pat.groove(swing, push, jitter, vel, drift, seed, grid), and stdlib presets (groove-straight, -pocket, -lazy, -bounce, -rolling, -cloud; -swing(pct, grid), -push(pct), -human(jitter, vel, seed)). Catalog recipes are the plain-Strudel lowering of the same values (swingBy, late, rand/perlin segmented per step, velocity) so they open on strudel.cc.

recipes.title: MPC swing on 16ths
recipes.intent: 16th hats at 58 % swing: every second 16th sits late, the downbeats stay put.

recipes.title: Lazy snare (push and pull per voice)
recipes.intent: Kick slightly early, snare dragged 12 % of a 16th, hats straight: the backbeat sits behind the beat.

recipes.title: Humanize (seeded timing and velocity)
recipes.intent: Hats with 4 % timing spread and 15 % velocity spread; deterministic, so an offline render repeats exactly.

recipes.title: Drag vs rush
recipes.intent: The same clap twice: dragged (+10 %) in the left ear, rushed (-10 %) in the right.

recipes.title: Tempo drift
recipes.intent: A keys part whose timing wanders slowly (smooth over four bars), like a player without a click.

syntax.title: Swing, push, humanize in one call (.groove)
syntax.explain: swing 50-75 (MPC %), push -50..50 and jitter 0-25 in % of a 16th, vel 0-0.5, drift 0-20, seed, grid

syntax.title: Groove presets with a seed per voice
syntax.explain: groove-pocket(1) and groove-pocket(2): same feel, voices do not move together
syntax.code:
setcpm(90/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-hiphop")
hooks.bind("kick", "bbKick | groove-pocket(1)"); hooks.bind("snare", "clap | groove-pocket(2) | groove-push(4)"); hooks.bind("hat", "hat | groove-pocket(3)")
kick: s(atoms.hh.boomKick).use("kick")
snare: s(atoms.hh.boomSnare).use("snare")
hats: s(atoms.hh.boomHats).use("hat")
